manifest.name: cicids2017
manifest.citation: Iman Sharafaldin, Arash Habibi Lashkari, and Ali A. Ghorbani, "Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset and Intrusion Traffic Characterization", 4th International Conference on Information Systems Security and Privacy (ICISSP), Portugal, January 2018.
manifest.license_notes: Operators must review the Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity terms before download. This repository does not redistribute the corpus.

feature_exclusions.Flow ID: Record identifier; can leak duplicates across splits.
feature_exclusions.Source IP: Capture-host artifact; not a portable flow statistic.
feature_exclusions.Destination IP: Capture-host artifact; not a portable flow statistic.
feature_exclusions.Source Port: Ephemeral client port; can group sessions unrealistically.
feature_exclusions.Timestamp: Used only for temporal splitting, never as a model feature.
feature_exclusions.Label: Target, not a predictor.

known_limitations: Flow records are not Linux process telemetry.
Public reports document label noise, duplicate flows, and extreme/Inf values.
Timestamp and IP fields can leak capture-session structure.
Class distribution is heavily imbalanced toward BENIGN.
A single CSV sample is not the full week-long corpus.
unavailable_until_inspected: timestamp coverage of the operator copy
